name: ARGO-L1 GPS receiver unit
notes: Redundant dual receiver assembly, GPS L1 C/A, 12 correlator channels, acquisition threshold 35 dB-Hz, warm start (90%) and cold start < 15 min (90%), timing accuracy < 0.1 us (1-sigma), accuracy 10 m and 0.1 m/s (3D rms), design life 7 years in LEO. The listed mass '< 1200 g' is for 2 antennas and 2 LNAs only (the receiver box mass is not declared), so mass_kg is null. Power 2.2 W is a single receiver (2.4 W with 2 LNAs). Box dimensions are configuration 1 (configuration 2: 51.0 x 216.6 x 109.4 mm); antenna 88.9 mm diameter x 28.7 mm. TID > 20 krad with 2 mm aluminium shielding. Antennas and LNAs are supplied.
Datasheet issue 20.2 (2026): flight heritage on 10+ nanosatellite missions; interfaces I2C, RS485, CAN and 2 x UART (command line, direct GNSS receiver access).
